## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Dabbhapupphajātaka* (Ja 400) is a narrative in the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. According to its commentary, the Buddha delivered the discourse while residing at Jetavana concerning the covetous monk Upananda of the Sakya clan [SuttaCentral; Fausböll 1883]. The framing verse and story recount a fable illustrating how quarreling results in mutual loss: two otters cooperatively catch a large carp (*rohitamaccha*) but quarrel over how to apportion it [Anandajoti 2010; Collins; Fausböll 1883]. They ask a passing jackal to arbitrate their dispute; the jackal acts as judge, awarding the head to one otter, the tail to the other, and taking the substantial middle portion for himself before returning to his mate, reflecting an ironic perspective on arbitration and jurisprudence [Anandajoti 2010; Collins; Fausböll 1883].
The commentary explains that the jackal receives the epithet *Dabbhapuppha* because his coat shares the color of the *dabbha*-grass blossom (*dabbhapupphasamānavaṇṇatāya*) [Fausböll 1883]. Modern scholarship notes the tale's popularity and transmission across Buddhist traditions [Crosby 2013]. In terms of text reuse, DharmaNexus identifies 16 matching passages between the text and the third volume of the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns the text cross-linguistically with the Sanskrit *Cīvaravastu* (11 matches), the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26), and Tibetan Vinaya and avadāna texts, notably the *Vinayasūtraṭīkā* (D 4120) and the *Bodhisattvāvadānakalpalatā* (D 4155) [DharmaNexus]. Four translations in four modern languages are recorded on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): Cīvaravastu (SA_K01_vinv07_u) [sa]; 中阿含經 (ZH_T01_0026) [zh]; འདུལ་བའི་མདོའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ། (vinayasūtraṭīkā) (D4120-2) [bo]; བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་རྟོགས་པ་བརྗོད་པ་དཔག་བསམ་གྱི་འཁྲི་ཤིང་། (bodhisatvāvadānakalpalatā) (D4155-2) [bo]
